definitions.parametrized_case_proxy: Literal-list/tuple decorator cardinality only, not an executed collection or subtest count.
definitions.assertion_kinds: Python assert, assert-prefixed method/helper calls, pytest.raises, AssertionError/pytest.fail/self.fail sentinels. Helper bodies and calls both retained, not runtime assertion totals.
